delivery.commit_subject: PKT-003: finalize Post-Incident and Evolution packet family

handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Copilot while Codex completes higher-priority work.

PKT-003 packet family complete. Three screens are packet-ready (Post-Incident Review Console, Evolution Center, Lineage View) with screen specs, BFF contracts, example payloads, and coordination response/request templates. Two screens (Inspiration Graph, Mutation Review) are blocked with explicit BFF gap requirements. Please review the packet family doc and all artifacts for correctness and acceptance criteria coverage.

Review changes requested: align Post-Incident telemetry fields with the example/W3 handoff ( vs flat metrics); fix Evolution Center Freeze Orders source ( conflicts with the stated active+historical scope and lifted example); align Lineage View graph empty-state field naming to  instead of ; expand Mutation Review's EVO-004 blocker note to name the four unresolved action paths (freeze, rollback, retrain, redeploy).

Addressed all four review changes: (1) telemetry_performance field shape in screen spec + BFF contract now references nested summary object matching the example payload; (2) Evolution Center Freeze Orders source changed to GET /api/v1/freeze-orders (no filter, active+historical per the example showing lifted status); (3) Lineage View graph empty-state condition updated to check edges field matching the lineage_graph response shape; (4) Mutation Review EVO-004 blocker note expanded to name all four unresolved action paths: freeze, rollback, retrain, redeploy.

Changes requested. See docs/reviews/PKT-003-review-codex.md. Remaining blockers: (1) all three PKT-003 Lovable YAMLs reference missing docs/pantheon-handoffs/PKT-003-* bundles / FRONTEND_CHANGE_SPEC.md files while contract-ready still claims the handoff bundle is published; (2) Lineage View .coordination handoff still says empty state should key off lineage_edges instead of lineage_graph.edges / edges[].

Both blocking items from docs/reviews/PKT-003-review-codex.md are resolved: (1) created the three missing handoff bundle FRONTEND_CHANGE_SPEC.md files — docs/pantheon-handoffs/PKT-003-post-incident-review/, PKT-003-evolution-center/, and PKT-003-lineage-view/; (2) Lineage View coordination files already reference lineage_graph.edges correctly. Please re-review the packet family and handoff bundles.

Changes requested. See docs/reviews/PKT-003-review-codex.md: Lineage View still claims the edge-detail drawer opens from an LN-01 list row, but LN-01 exposes no edge_id or other stable edge selector. Align the screen spec, BFF contract, example payload, and handoff bundle on a trigger path the frontend can actually implement.

The Lineage View interaction contract is now consistent across all artifacts. Edge Detail drawer is triggered by graph-edge click (edge_id from lineage_graph.edges[].id / LN-03), not list-row selection. Updated: docs/screens/PKT-003-lineage-view.md, docs/pantheon-handoffs/PKT-003-lineage-view/FRONTEND_CHANGE_SPEC.md, .coordination/responses/PKT-003-lineage-view-lovable-ui-task.yaml, .coordination/responses/PKT-003-lineage-view-contract-ready.yaml. BFF contract and example payload are unchanged (already correct). Please re-review.

Re-review passed: Lineage View now consistently opens edge detail from graph-edge selection, and the PKT-003 packet family still preserves explicit ready-vs-blocked boundaries. Ready for owner close-out.
